notes: First version: install ErvisioTodo with Docker, start, stop, restart, live logs, updates, workspace settings, test email and a usage widget.

manifest.name: ErvisioTodo
manifest.author: Riccardo Reccia
manifest.description: Install, run and update ErvisioTodo on this machine with Docker: workspace settings, mail test, live logs and updates.

commands.name: has-docker
commands.description: Check whether Docker is installed (to find the ErvisioTodo containers, and before installing)

commands.name: user
commands.description: Read your user name (root uses Docker without an unlock prompt)

commands.name: groups
commands.description: Read your groups (members of docker use Docker without an unlock prompt)

commands.name: install-docker
argv: systemctl stop ervisio-todo-install.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed ervisio-todo-install.service 2>/dev/null; exec systemd-run --unit=ervisio-todo-install --description='Install ErvisioTodo (Docker)' --remain-after-exit --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin sh -c "$0" install-docker "$1" "$2"

set -eu
v="$1"; url="$2"; d=/opt/ervisio-todo
command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo "Docker is not installed"; exit 1; }
if [ ! -f "$d/deploy/ervisio-setup.sh" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$d"
  u="https://github.com/Ervisio/ErvisioTodo/archive/refs/tags/v$v.tar.gz"
  echo "Downloading $u"
  if command -v curl >/dev/null; then curl -fsSL "$u"; else wget -qO- "$u"; fi | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "$d"
fi
cd "$d" && exec ./deploy/ervisio-setup.sh --url "$url"
commands.description: Install ErvisioTodo with Docker in /opt/ervisio-todo: download the release matching this plugin from GitHub and run deploy/ervisio-setup.sh in a systemd unit (ervisio-todo-install), which starts the Docker Compose stack

commands.name: install-state
commands.description: Read the state of the installation unit (ervisio-todo-install)

commands.name: install-log
commands.description: Read the output of the installation (the journal of ervisio-todo-install)

commands.name: update-docker
argv: systemctl stop ervisio-todo-update.service 2>/dev/null; systemctl reset-failed ervisio-todo-update.service 2>/dev/null; exec systemd-run --unit=ervisio-todo-update --description='Update ErvisioTodo (Docker)' --remain-after-exit --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin sh -c "$0" update-docker "$1"

set -eu
v="$1"; d=/opt/ervisio-todo
[ -f "$d/compose.yaml" ] || { echo "No Docker installation in $d"; exit 1; }
cd "$d"
ts=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
echo "==> backup"
if [ -f .env ]; then cp -p .env ".env.bak-$ts"; echo "Saved $d/.env.bak-$ts"; else echo "No .env to back up"; fi
echo "Data stays in the Docker volume ervisiotodo_todo-data: the update does not touch it"
touch .env
if grep -q '^ERVISIO_VERSION=' .env; then sed -i "s/^ERVISIO_VERSION=.*/ERVISIO_VERSION=$v/" .env; else echo "ERVISIO_VERSION=$v" >> .env; fi
echo "Set ERVISIO_VERSION=$v in $d/.env"
echo "==> pull"
docker compose pull app
echo "==> up"
docker compose up -d
echo "==> done"
commands.description: Update the Docker installation in /opt/ervisio-todo to a release, in a systemd unit (ervisio-todo-update): back up .env next to itself, set ERVISIO_VERSION in .env, docker compose pull app, docker compose up -d

commands.name: update-state
commands.description: Read the state of the update unit (ervisio-todo-update)

commands.name: update-log
commands.description: Read the output of the update (the journal of ervisio-todo-update)
